name: func_8001DFCC
function_evidence: Builds a 132-byte GPU packet sequence and returns the next byte cursor. Arguments are an ordering-table word, packet cursor, x/y coordinates, width, height, border extension, CVECTOR pointer, unsigned shade multiplier, and flags. Uses SDK LINE_F4 (two), LINE_F2 (two), POLY_G4 and DR_TPAGE layouts; all packet pointers and fields propagate those types. Copies the complete four-byte CVECTOR through an explicitly aligned word view, including its command byte, before scaling RGB channels; this is an intentional packed word copy rather than a scalar color type. Flags bit 7 selects quad transparency and bits 0-1 select draw blending mode. GetGraphType is the sole dependency and is called again when its first result is not 1. Narrow coordinate intermediates and x/y/width parameter declarations reproduce the compiler output; the original source-level widths of promoted coordinate arguments remain uncertain. No globals or strings are referenced. Both boundaries are complete: the preceding function returns at 0x8001DFC4 with delay slot at 0x8001DFC8; this function returns at 0x8001E40C with delay slot at 0x8001E410, and a separate routine starts at 0x8001E414. No split or dependency blocker was found. The selected object reports 100.000% diagnostic similarity; pinned full-image validation remains supervisor-owned.
